name: Tuomo Suntola
summary: Finnish inventor of Atomic Layer Epitaxy (ALE) and Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD).

name: Tampere
summary: City in Finland where Tuomo Suntola was born.

name: Helsinki University of Technology
summary: University where Tuomo Suntola studied electrical engineering.

name: VTT Semiconductor Laboratory
summary: Laboratory where Suntola worked on humidity sensors and ALE initiation.

name: Instrumentarium Oy
summary: Company where Suntola invented ALE in 1974.

name: Lohja Oy
summary: Company that bought the ALE-EL project from Instrumentarium in 1978.

name: Microchemistry Ltd.
summary: Company founded by Suntola in 1987 as a subsidiary of Neste.

name: Neste Oy
summary: National oil company that owned Microchemistry Ltd.

name: ASM
summary: Dutch company that bought Microchemistry in 1999.

name: Atomic Layer Deposition
summary: Thin film growth technique invented by Suntola.

name: Humicap sensor
summary: Humidity sensor developed by Suntola and Antson.

name: European SEMI Award 2004
summary: Award honoring Suntola as pioneer in ALD.
